name: sprite_builder_codespace_exec
description: Run an arbitrary bash command in the codespace, from /workspace/app. Returns {output (merged stdout+stderr), exit_code}. Project env-var values are redacted from output. Codespace must be 'ready'. Use for builds, tests, installs, inspection.

codespace_id.description: The codespace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_codespace / sprite_builder_list_codespaces).

cmd.description: Shell command to run, e.g. 'cargo test 2>&1 | tail -20'.
